title: The Speakeasy Murder

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: You’ve found the perfect corporate event entertainment choice in for your event! Set in a lively 1920s nightclub, this interactive, family-friendly (and corporate-culture friendly) whodunit combines intrigue, humor, and toe-tapping entertainment. With four full-length songs performed live, characters engaging with each other and the audience, and a suspenseful conclusion that sends someone to the big house and someone else to the morgue, the show guarantees an evening of memorable excitement. Ideal for planners seeking quality, affordable, turnkey entertainment, The Speakeasy Murder will leave your attendees raving long after the last curtain call. services.desc: Treat your special someone to a night they’ll never forget with our Romance Package for Two at The Speakeasy Murder. Perfect for a date night, anniversary, or just a little old-fashioned romance, this indulgent experience begins with a chilled glass of champagne to set the mood. Then, savor our prix fixe filet dinner featuring a tender 8 oz filet paired with a decadent 4 oz lobster tail - a duo as perfect as the two of you. To finish, share a rich slice of New York-style cheesecake with two spoons, because love is sweeter when it’s shared.
